root_cause: assessQueuePressure sanitized all fields through Number(value)||0, allowing malformed, absent-as-null, negative and fractional GitHub counter telemetry to become zero free capacity and unlock optional dispatch.

observed_evidence.risk_scenario: GitHub count 'unavailable' or null, inProgress 2 => optional parallel candidate could be allowed
observed_evidence.impact: Preventive fail-closed queue capacity guard; no claimed speed gain

fix: Require all six counters to be finite, nonnegative safe integers before optional dispatch; expose invalidCountKeys; hold mutation and allow read-only independent work on any invalid count. Preserve the existing exact-ID verified ghost classifier and native singleflight scheduler.
prevention_rule: Malformed provider queue counters are untrusted evidence, never zero capacity. Do not add schedulers, disable required checks or count unresolved zero-job provider runs as removed. Replay negative counters and preserve valid zero/integer capacity decisions.

invariants: invalid non-integer queue telemetry blocks optional dispatch and write mutations
positive or zero trusted integers retain original bounded capacity semantics
no extra scheduler or API lookups
